pages.heading: Farseer
pages.body: Near the world border. Extremely hostile; its beam and claws can bypass armor protection. A Shattered Dimensional Carver can move enormous distances

pages.heading: Farseer (cont.)
pages.body: toward its range, subject to server boundaries. Its arm makes a Transmutation Table, exchanging stacks at an experience cost. Breaking that table destroys its learned choices and causes an explosion; plan its location carefully.
